network: normalized DFT3 P3; propagation D -> C3 -> C2 -> C1
model: Hammerstad-Jensen zero-thickness first pass; copper thickness and dispersion deferred to field solver

C2.implementation: two 3 dB branch-line hybrids as Mach-Zehnder coupler

board.connector_type: edge-launch SMA, footprint selected after vendor model

release_gates: Import actual laminate lot and copper roughness into a 2.5D or 3D field solver
Tune bends, tees, launches, and hybrid junction discontinuities
At 2.45 GHz: insertion loss <= 1.5 dB, amplitude imbalance <= 0.5 dB, phase error <= 5 deg, return loss >= 15 dB, isolation >= 15 dB
Cascade P3dagger * P3 reconstruction spectral-norm residual <= 0.10 across retained band
